headline: Bloomberg reports that Asbis, an electronics distributor listed in Warsaw, is aiming at data centres and AI to keep its 476% share-price rally going.
score_reason: Lowered from 4: only the headline could be checked, from a single outlet, so the period of the rally and the company's plans are unverified.
importance_line: Investors in Asbis and in AI-hardware suppliers are affected first, then the company and its customers, and the doubt is that the period of the 476% rise and the company's plans are not known beyond Bloomberg's headline.
summary: Bloomberg reports that Asbis, an electronics distributor listed in Warsaw, is targeting data centres and AI as it seeks to sustain a 476% rise in its share price.
